Salman Khan to begin Raj & DK superhero film before SVC63 wrap

Actor Salman Khan is reportedly set to commence work on a superhero film directed by Raj and DK. This project is expected to begin before the completion of his current film, SVC63. Producer Dil Raju has confirmed that Khan will feature multiple looks in SVC63, with details about the number of looks being revealed.
